```{r Histogram with distrubition for cytotoxity at 32 and 37°C FIGURE 2}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load your dataset (CSV)
# ---------------------------------------------------
dat <- read.csv("Figure_2.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(dat) <- trimws(names(dat))

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare data
# ---------------------------------------------------
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Cytotoxicity_R1 = as.numeric(Cytotoxicity_R1),
    Cytotoxicity_R2 = as.numeric(Cytotoxicity_R2),

    Average_Cytotoxicity = rowMeans(
      dplyr::select(., Cytotoxicity_R1, Cytotoxicity_R2),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    panC_group = dplyr::recode(panC_group, "II" = "II", "VI" = "VI"),

    # Make Temperature consistent (handles "32", "32°C", 32, etc.)
    Temperature = gsub("\\s+", "", as.character(Temperature)),
    Temperature = ifelse(Temperature %in% c("32", "32C", "32°C"), "32°C",
                  ifelse(Temperature %in% c("37", "37C", "37°C"), "37°C", Temperature)),
    Temperature = factor(Temperature, levels = c("32°C", "37°C"))
  )

dat <- dat %>% filter(Temperature %in% c("32°C", "37°C"))

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 3. Updated colors
# ---------------------------------------------------
temp_colors <- c(
  "32°C" = "#3D5A6C",
  "37°C" = "#9B2915"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 4. Clean theme (default R font)
# ---------------------------------------------------
cyto_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 5. Function: histogram + density by Temperature
# ---------------------------------------------------
make_cyto_plot <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Average_Cytotoxicity,
                   fill = Temperature,
                   color = Temperature)) +
    geom_histogram(
      aes(y = after_stat(density)),
      binwidth = 0.05,
      alpha = 0.35,
      position = "identity",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = temp_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = temp_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.5, 1.2),
      breaks = seq(-0.5, 1.2, 0.2)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Average Cytotoxicity",
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    cyto_theme
}

# ---------------------------------------------------
# 6. Split and plot
# ---------------------------------------------------
dat_II <- dat %>% filter(panC_group == "II")
dat_VI <- dat %>% filter(panC_group == "VI")

cyto_II <- make_cyto_plot(dat_II)
print(cyto_II)

ggsave("Cyto_Histogram_panC_II.png",
       plot = cyto_II,
       device = "png",
       height = 6, width = 10, units = "in")

cyto_VI <- make_cyto_plot(dat_VI)
print(cyto_VI)

ggsave("Cyto_Histogram_panC_VI.png",
       plot = cyto_VI,
       device = "png",
       height = 6, width = 10, units = "in")
```

```{r LMM and Plot the cytotoxicity Data For growth media and Temp FIGURE 3 }
# =========================
# Load libraries
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyr)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Load data (10 & 32 °C cytotoxicity) 
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv("Figure_3.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(df) <- trimws(names(df))  # helps if CSV has trailing spaces in headers

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Isolate         = factor(Isolate),
    panC_group      = factor(panC_group),
    Media           = factor(Media),
    Temperature     = factor(Temperature, levels = c(10, 32)),
    Cytotoxicity_R1 = as.numeric(Cytotoxicity_R1),
    Cytotoxicity_R2 = as.numeric(Cytotoxicity_R2)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Biological means per isolate (mean of technical reps)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
iso_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Cytotoxicity_mean = rowMeans(
      dplyr::across(c(Cytotoxicity_R1, Cytotoxicity_R2)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. LMM on 10 & 32 (BHI vs SMB, both clades)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
med_dd <- iso_data %>%
  filter(
    Temperature %in% c(10, 32),
    Media %in% c("BHI", "SMB")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Temperature = factor(Temperature, levels = c(10, 32)),
    Media       = factor(Media,       levels = c("BHI", "SMB"))
  )

cyto_lmm <- lmer(
  Cytotoxicity_mean ~ Media * Temperature * panC_group + (1 | Isolate),
  data = med_dd
)

cat("\n=== LMM (10 vs 32 °C, BHI vs SMB): Cytotoxicity_mean ~ Media * Temperature * panC_group + (1|Isolate) ===\n")
print(summary(cyto_lmm))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4a. Temperature contrasts within Media × panC (10 vs 32)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
emm_temp <- emmeans(cyto_lmm, ~ Temperature | Media * panC_group)
tuk_temp <- pairs(emm_temp, adjust = "tukey")
cat("\n=== Tukey: Temperature (10 vs 32) within Media × panC_group ===\n")
print(tuk_temp)

p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < 0.0001, "****",
  ifelse(p < 0.001,  "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,   "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,   "*", "ns"))))
}

temp_sig_tbl <- as.data.frame(tuk_temp) %>%
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("Temp1", "Temp2"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(
    Temp1      = gsub("Temperature", "", Temp1),
    Temp2      = gsub("Temperature", "", Temp2),
    stars      = p_to_stars(p.value),
    Media      = as.character(Media),
    panC_group = as.character(panC_group)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4b. Medium contrasts within Temperature × panC (BHI vs SMB)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
emm_med <- emmeans(cyto_lmm, ~ Media | Temperature * panC_group)
tuk_med <- pairs(emm_med, adjust = "tukey")
cat("\n=== Tukey: Media (BHI vs SMB) within Temperature × panC_group ===\n")
print(tuk_med)

med_sig_tbl <- as.data.frame(tuk_med) %>%
  mutate(
    Temperature = as.character(Temperature),
    panC_group  = as.character(panC_group),
    stars       = p_to_stars(p.value)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Plotting function (like RT-qPCR figure but for cytotoxicity)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
make_clade_cyto_plot <- function(clade_label, iso_data, temp_sig, med_sig) {

  dat <- iso_data %>%
    filter(panC_group == clade_label) %>%
    mutate(
      Temp_factor = factor(Temperature, levels = c(10, 32))
    )

  # Mean ± SD per Media × Temp
  sum_bar <- dat %>%
    group_by(Media, Temp_factor) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cyto = mean(Cytotoxicity_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cyto   = sd(Cytotoxicity_mean,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups   = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sd_cyto = ifelse(is.na(sd_cyto), 0, sd_cyto))

  media_cols <- c("BHI" = "#7D6652", "SMB" = "#769776")

  pd  <- position_dodge(width = 1.0)
  pjd <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 1.0)

  p <- ggplot(sum_bar,
              aes(x = Temp_factor,
                  y = mean_cyto,
                  fill = Media)) +
    geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.55, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_cyto - sd_cyto,
                      ymax = mean_cyto + sd_cyto),
                  position = pd, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = Temp_factor, y = Cytotoxicity_mean, fill = Media),
      position = pjd, size = 2, shape = 21, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = media_cols) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.1, 1.5), breaks = seq(-0.1, 1.5, 0.2)) +
    labs(
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = "Average Normalized Cytotoxicity"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  #### 1) TEMP EFFECT STARS (10 vs 32) WITHIN EACH MEDIUM
  if (!is.null(temp_sig) && nrow(temp_sig) > 0) {

    temp_cl <- temp_sig %>%
      filter(panC_group == clade_label)

    # BHI: 10 vs 32
    temp_BHI <- temp_cl %>%
      filter(Media == "BHI") %>%
      mutate(
        x1   = match(Temp1, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x2   = match(Temp2, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        xmid = (x1 + x2) / 2,
        y    = max(sum_bar$mean_cyto + sum_bar$sd_cyto, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2))

    # SMB: 10 vs 32
    temp_SMB <- temp_cl %>%
      filter(Media == "SMB") %>%
      mutate(
        x1   = match(Temp1, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x2   = match(Temp2, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        xmid = (x1 + x2) / 2,
        y    = max(sum_bar$mean_cyto + sum_bar$sd_cyto, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.55
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2))

    if (nrow(temp_BHI) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = temp_BHI,
          aes(x = x1 - 0.28, xend = x2 - 0.28,
              y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.6,
          color = "#7D6652"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = temp_BHI,
          aes(x = xmid - 0.28, y = y + 0.03, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 4,
          color = "#7D6652"
        )
    }

    if (nrow(temp_SMB) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = temp_SMB,
          aes(x = x1 + 0.28, xend = x2 + 0.28,
              y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.6,
          color = "#769776"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = temp_SMB,
          aes(x = xmid + 0.28, y = y + 0.03, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 4,
          color = "#769776"
        )
    }
  }

  #### 2) MEDIUM EFFECT STARS (BHI vs SMB at 10 & 32)
  if (!is.null(med_sig) && nrow(med_sig) > 0) {

    med_cl <- med_sig %>%
      filter(panC_group == clade_label) %>%
      mutate(
        x    = match(Temperature, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x1   = x - 0.23,
        x2   = x + 0.23,
        xmid = x,
        y    = max(sum_bar$mean_cyto + sum_bar$sd_cyto, na.rm = TRUE) + 1.0 +
          0.3 * (row_number() - 1)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x))

    if (nrow(med_cl) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = med_cl,
          aes(x = x1, xend = x2,
              y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.6,
          color = "#000000"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = med_cl,
          aes(x = xmid, y = y + 0.03, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 4,
          color = "#000000"
        )
    }
  }

  p
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Generate plots for each panC group
## ------------------------------------------------------------
clades <- levels(iso_data$panC_group)
plot_list <- list()

for (cl in clades) {
  nm <- paste0("group_", cl)
  plot_list[[nm]] <- make_clade_cyto_plot(
    clade_label = cl,
    iso_data    = iso_data,
    temp_sig    = temp_sig_tbl,
    med_sig     = med_sig_tbl
  )
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Save plots
## ------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("Cytotox_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (cl in clades) {
  nm <- paste0("group_", cl)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("Cytotox_plots", paste0("cytotox_", nm, ".png")),
    plot     = plot_list[[nm]],
    width    = 5,
    height   = 5,
    dpi      = 600
  )
}
```

```{r LMM and Plot the Log2FC Data For growth media and Temp FIGURE 4 }
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 0. SETTINGS
## ------------------------------------------------------------
FILE_IN   <- "Figure_4.csv"
OUT_DIR   <- "RtqPCR_plots"

GENES_USE  <- c("hblC", "nheA", "plc", "sph")
GROUPS_USE <- c("II", "VI")
MEDIA_USE  <- c("BHI", "SMB")

TEMPS_PLOT <- c(10, 32, 37)   # plotted
TEMPS_LMM  <- c(10, 32)       # modeled

Y_LIM_LOW  <- -10
Y_LIM_HIGH <-  10

## p → stars helper
p_to_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
         ifelse(p < 0.0001, "****",
                ifelse(p < 0.001,  "***",
                       ifelse(p < 0.01,   "**",
                              ifelse(p < 0.05,   "*", "ns")))))
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Load data (log2FC already, vs 37 °C)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df <- read.csv(FILE_IN, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Isolate     = factor(Isolate),
    panC_group  = factor(panC_group),
    Media       = factor(Media),
    Temperature = as.numeric(Temperature)    # 10, 32, 37
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Wide → long
## ------------------------------------------------------------
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(GENES_USE),
    names_to  = "Gene",
    values_to = "log2FC"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene   = factor(Gene, levels = GENES_USE),
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC)
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Biological means per isolate (collapse technical reps)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
iso_bio <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Isolate, panC_group, Media, Temperature, Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. LMM on 10 & 32 only (BHI vs SMB)
## ------------------------------------------------------------
med_dd <- iso_bio %>%
  filter(
    Temperature %in% TEMPS_LMM,
    Media %in% MEDIA_USE,
    panC_group %in% GROUPS_USE,
    Gene %in% GENES_USE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Temperature = factor(Temperature, levels = TEMPS_LMM),
    Media       = factor(Media,       levels = MEDIA_USE),
    panC_group  = factor(panC_group,  levels = GROUPS_USE),
    Gene        = factor(Gene,        levels = GENES_USE)
  )

med_lmm <- lmer(
  log2FC ~ Media * Temperature * panC_group * Gene + (1 | Isolate),
  data = med_dd
)

cat("\n=== LMM (10 vs 32 °C, BHI vs SMB): log2FC ~ Media * Temperature * panC_group * Gene + (1|Isolate) ===\n")
print(summary(med_lmm))

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4a. Temperature contrasts (10 vs 32) within panC × Media × Gene
## ------------------------------------------------------------
emm_temp <- emmeans(med_lmm, ~ Temperature | panC_group * Media * Gene)
tuk_temp <- pairs(emm_temp, adjust = "tukey")

cat("\n=== Tukey: Temperature (10 vs 32) within panC × Media × Gene ===\n")
print(tuk_temp)

temp_sig_tbl <- as.data.frame(tuk_temp) %>%
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("Temp1", "Temp2"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(
    Temp1      = gsub("Temperature", "", Temp1),
    Temp2      = gsub("Temperature", "", Temp2),
    panC_group = as.character(panC_group),
    Media      = as.character(Media),
    Gene       = as.character(Gene),
    stars      = p_to_stars(p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(panC_group, Media, Gene, Temp1, Temp2, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value, stars) %>%
  distinct(panC_group, Media, Gene, Temp1, Temp2, .keep_all = TRUE)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 4b. Media contrasts (BHI vs SMB) within panC × Temperature × Gene
## ------------------------------------------------------------
emm_med <- emmeans(med_lmm, ~ Media | panC_group * Temperature * Gene)
tuk_med <- pairs(emm_med, adjust = "tukey")

cat("\n=== Tukey: Media (BHI vs SMB) within panC × Temperature × Gene ===\n")
print(tuk_med)

med_sig_tbl <- as.data.frame(tuk_med) %>%
  tidyr::separate(contrast, into = c("Med1", "Med2"), sep = " - ") %>%
  mutate(
    Med1        = gsub("Media", "", Med1),
    Med2        = gsub("Media", "", Med2),
    panC_group  = as.character(panC_group),
    Temperature = as.character(Temperature),
    Gene        = as.character(Gene),
    stars       = p_to_stars(p.value)
  ) %>%
  select(panC_group, Temperature, Gene, Med1, Med2, estimate, SE, df, t.ratio, p.value, stars) %>%
  distinct(panC_group, Temperature, Gene, Med1, Med2, .keep_all = TRUE)

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Plotting function
## ------------------------------------------------------------
make_group_gene_plot <- function(clade_label, gene_label,
                                 iso_data, temp_sig, med_sig) {

  ## data for plotting
  dat <- iso_data %>%
    filter(
      panC_group == clade_label,
      Gene       == gene_label,
      Media %in% MEDIA_USE,
      Temperature %in% TEMPS_PLOT
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Temp_factor = factor(Temperature, levels = TEMPS_PLOT),
      Media = factor(Media, levels = MEDIA_USE)
    )

  ## Mean ± SD per Media × Temp
  sum_bar <- dat %>%
    group_by(Media, Temp_factor) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_log2FC   = sd(log2FC,   na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups     = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sd_log2FC = ifelse(is.na(sd_log2FC), 0, sd_log2FC))

  ## Colors
  media_cols <- c("BHI" = "#7D6652", "SMB" = "#769776")

  ## Positioning
  pd  <- position_dodge(width = 1.0)
  pjd <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12, dodge.width = 1.0)

  ## Fixed y-axis limits
  y_lim_low  <- Y_LIM_LOW
  y_lim_high <- Y_LIM_HIGH

  ## Base plot
  p <- ggplot(sum_bar,
              aes(x = Temp_factor,
                  y = mean_log2FC,
                  fill = Media)) +
    geom_col(position = pd, width = 0.55, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_log2FC - sd_log2FC,
                      ymax = mean_log2FC + sd_log2FC),
                  position = pd, width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(
      data = dat,
      aes(x = Temp_factor, y = log2FC, fill = Media),
      position = pjd, size = 2.4, shape = 21, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = media_cols) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(y_lim_low, y_lim_high),
      breaks = seq(y_lim_low, y_lim_high, by = 2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    labs(
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = expression(log[2] * "FC")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      # keep/remove this line depending on whether you want Times:
      # text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18),
      plot.title   = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(10, 18, 10, 10)
    )

  #### --------------------------------------------------------------
  #### 1) TEMP EFFECT STARS (10 vs 32) WITHIN EACH MEDIUM
  #### --------------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(temp_sig) && nrow(temp_sig) > 0) {

    temp_this <- temp_sig %>%
      filter(
        panC_group == clade_label,
        Gene == gene_label
      )

    y_temp_BHI <- y_lim_high - 0.6
    y_temp_SMB <- y_lim_high - 1.8

    # BHI
    temp_BHI <- temp_this %>%
      filter(Media == "BHI") %>%
      mutate(
        x1   = match(Temp1, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x2   = match(Temp2, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        xmid = (x1 + x2) / 2,
        y    = y_temp_BHI
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2))

    # SMB
    temp_SMB <- temp_this %>%
      filter(Media == "SMB") %>%
      mutate(
        x1   = match(Temp1, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x2   = match(Temp2, levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        xmid = (x1 + x2) / 2,
        y    = y_temp_SMB
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x1), !is.na(x2))

    if (nrow(temp_BHI) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = temp_BHI,
          aes(x = x1 - 0.28, xend = x2 - 0.28, y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.75,
          color = "#7D6652"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = temp_BHI,
          aes(x = xmid - 0.28, y = y + 0.15, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 5.3,
          color = "#7D6652"
        )
    }

    if (nrow(temp_SMB) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = temp_SMB,
          aes(x = x1 + 0.28, xend = x2 + 0.28, y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.75,
          color = "#769776"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = temp_SMB,
          aes(x = xmid + 0.28, y = y + 0.15, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 5.3,
          color = "#769776"
        )
    }
  }

  #### --------------------------------------------------------------
  #### 2) MEDIUM EFFECT STARS (BHI vs SMB at 10 & 32)
  #### --------------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(med_sig) && nrow(med_sig) > 0) {

    med_this <- med_sig %>%
      filter(
        panC_group == clade_label,
        Gene == gene_label,
        Temperature %in% c("10", "32")
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Temperature = factor(Temperature, levels = c("10", "32"))
      ) %>%
      arrange(Temperature)

    y_med_10 <- y_lim_high - 2.8
    y_med_32 <- y_lim_high - 3.6

    med_gene <- med_this %>%
      mutate(
        x    = match(as.character(Temperature), levels(dat$Temp_factor)),
        x1   = x - 0.23,
        x2   = x + 0.23,
        xmid = x,
        y    = ifelse(as.character(Temperature) == "10", y_med_10, y_med_32)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(x))

    if (nrow(med_gene) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_segment(
          data = med_gene,
          aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          linewidth = 0.75,
          color = "black"
        ) +
        geom_text(
          data = med_gene,
          aes(x = xmid, y = y + 0.15, label = stars),
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          vjust = 0,
          size  = 5.3,
          color = "black"
        )
    }
  }

  p
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Generate all groups × gene plots
## ------------------------------------------------------------
plot_list <- list()

for (cl in GROUPS_USE) {
  for (g in GENES_USE) {
    nm <- paste0("Group", cl, "_", g)
    plot_list[[nm]] <- make_group_gene_plot(
      clade_label = cl,
      gene_label  = g,
      iso_data    = iso_bio,
      temp_sig    = temp_sig_tbl,
      med_sig     = med_sig_tbl
    )
  }
}

## ------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Save plots
## ------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (nm in names(plot_list)) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(nm, ".png")),
    plot     = plot_list[[nm]],
    width    = 5,
    height   = 5,
    dpi      = 600
  )
}

cat("\nSaved plots to: ", OUT_DIR, "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r Plot the Treated Supernatant data and run ANOVA and Tukey Test FIGURE 5}
# =========================
# Load libraries
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(agricolae)
library(scales)

# =========================
# File path 
# =========================
file_path <- "Figure_5.csv"

# =========================
# Treatment Colors
# =========================
treatment_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "#32746D",
  "Trypsin" = "#32746D",
  "Trypsin_Mucin" = "#32746D",
  "65_1" = "#32746D",
  "65_2" = "#32746D",
  "75_1" = "#32746D",
  "75_2" = "#32746D",
  "100_1" = "#32746D",
  "100_2" = "#32746D",
  "pH_2" = "#32746D",
  "pH_5" = "#32746D"
)

# =========================
# Label mappings
# =========================
new_labels <- c(
  "Control" = "Untreated",
  "Trypsin" = "Trypsin",
  "Trypsin_Mucin" = "Trypsin + Mucin",
  "65_1" = "65°C 1 minute",
  "65_2" = "65°C 2 minutes",
  "75_1" = "75°C 1 minute",
  "75_2" = "75°C 2 minutes",
  "100_1" = "100°C 1 minute",
  "100_2" = "100°C 2 minutes",
  "pH_2" = "pH 2",
  "pH_5" = "pH 5"
)

# =========================
# Plotting + Analysis Function
# =========================
process_experiment <- function(experiment_name, file_path) {
  
  # ---- Load CSV
  data <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(data) <- trimws(names(data))  # trims "Experiment " style issues
  
  # ---- Basic checks
  stopifnot(all(c("Experiment", "Treatment", "ISOLATE") %in% names(data)))
  
  # ---- Filter to one experiment
  data_exp <- data %>% 
    filter(Experiment == experiment_name)
  
  # ---- Identify replicate columns robustly
  rep_cols <- grep("^R\\d+(_Cytotoxicity)?$", names(data_exp), value = TRUE)
  if (length(rep_cols) == 0) {
    stop("No replicate columns found (expected R1_Cytotoxicity / R2_Cytotoxicity or R1/R2).")
  }
  
  # ---- Reshape to long format
  data_long <- data_exp %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(rep_cols),
      names_to = "Replicate",
      values_to = "Cytotoxicity"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Cytotoxicity)) %>%
    mutate(
      ISOLATE = factor(ISOLATE),
      Treatment = factor(
        Treatment,
        levels = c("Control", setdiff(unique(as.character(Treatment)), "Control"))
      )
    )
  
  # ---- ANOVA on all replicate values
  anova_result <- aov(Cytotoxicity ~ Treatment, data = data_long)
  
  print(paste("ANOVA for Experiment:", experiment_name))
  print(summary(anova_result))
  
  # ---- Tukey HSD (Treatment only)
  tukey_hsd <- TukeyHSD(anova_result, which = "Treatment")
  tukey_df <- as.data.frame(tukey_hsd$Treatment)
  tukey_df$Comparison <- rownames(tukey_df)
  
  control_vs <- tukey_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(grepl("Control", Comparison)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Comparison, diff, lwr, upr, p_adj = `p adj`)
  
  print("Tukey HSD: Control vs each treatment")
  print(control_vs)
  
  # ---- Agricolae Group Letters (based on full replicate-level stats)
  tukey_result_agricolae <- HSD.test(anova_result, "Treatment", group = TRUE)
  tukey_letters <- tukey_result_agricolae$groups
  
  # ---- Average biological reps within each isolate for plotting only
  isolate_means <- data_long %>%
    group_by(ISOLATE, Treatment) %>%
    summarize(
      Cytotoxicity = mean(Cytotoxicity, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # ---- Summary Data for bars/error bars based on isolate averages
  summary_data <- isolate_means %>%
    group_by(Treatment) %>%
    summarize(
      avg_cytotoxicity = mean(Cytotoxicity, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_cytotoxicity  = sd(Cytotoxicity, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      tukey_letters = tukey_letters$groups[
        match(as.character(Treatment), rownames(tukey_letters))
      ]
    )
  
  # ---- Keep only colors/labels that exist in this experiment
  cols_use   <- treatment_colors[names(treatment_colors) %in% as.character(summary_data$Treatment)]
  labels_use <- new_labels[names(new_labels) %in% as.character(summary_data$Treatment)]
  
  # ---- Plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data,
              aes(x = Treatment, y = avg_cytotoxicity, fill = Treatment)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, color = "black") +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = avg_cytotoxicity - sd_cytotoxicity,
        ymax = avg_cytotoxicity + sd_cytotoxicity
      ),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = tukey_letters,
        y = avg_cytotoxicity + sd_cytotoxicity + 0.13
      ),
      size = 7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_use) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_use) +
    geom_jitter(
      data = isolate_means,
      aes(x = Treatment, y = Cytotoxicity),
      width = 0.2,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.8,
      color = "black",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Average Cytotoxicity (Mean ± SD)") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.25, 1.0),
      breaks = seq(-0.2, 1.0, by = 0.2),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 20, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  return(list(
    plot = p,
    control_pvalues = control_vs,
    isolate_means = isolate_means,
    summary_data = summary_data
  ))
}

# =========================
# Loop across experiments (CSV)
# =========================
dat0 <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(dat0) <- trimws(names(dat0))
experiments <- unique(dat0$Experiment)

for (exp_name in experiments) {
  result <- process_experiment(exp_name, file_path)
  
  safe_exp <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", as.character(exp_name))
  
  # ---- Save Plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(safe_exp, "_Treated_plot.png"),
    plot = result$plot,
    width = 7,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 600
  )
  
  # ---- Save Control vs Tukey
  write.csv(
    result$control_pvalues,
    paste0(safe_exp, "_Control_vs_Tukey_pvalues.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # ---- Optional: save isolate-level means used for plotting
  write.csv(
    result$isolate_means,
    paste0(safe_exp, "_Isolate_means_for_plotting.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r Plot the Change of growth of isolates at 6°C FIGURE S1}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load the data from CSV
Change_OD <- read.csv("Figure_S1.csv")

# Reorder isolates so they group by panC group
Change_OD$Isolate <- factor(
  Change_OD$Isolate,
  levels = c(
    Change_OD$Isolate[Change_OD$panC_group == "II"],
    Change_OD$Isolate[Change_OD$panC_group == "VI"]
  )
)

# Filter only groups II and VI
filtered_data <- Change_OD %>%
  filter(panC_group %in% c("II", "VI"))

# Plot
changegrowth <- ggplot(filtered_data,
                       aes(x = Isolate,
                           y = Change_in_Growth,
                           fill = panC_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(),
           width = 0.5,
           color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Isolate",
    y = "Difference in Growth (OD600)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "II" = "#548687",
    "VI" = "#E55934"
  )) +
  facet_grid(~panC_group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1.6))

print(changegrowth)

# ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(Change_in_Growth ~ panC_group, data = filtered_data)
summary(anova_result)

# Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = "Figure_S1.pdf",
  plot = changegrowth,
  height = 6,
  width = 16,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600
)
```
